title: Separate provider PoR wallet labels from official address-file matches and signing-infrastructure attribution from key leakage

decisions.rule: Provider or explorer labels are a sourced attribution claim, not an official address-file match. Only set official_binance_file_match=true after downloading the relevant Binance PoR address file, preserving its exact hash, snapshot date and matching address/network. Do not calculate post-incident asset reserve ratios from labels alone.

A valid wallet signature and a reported signing-infrastructure compromise do not prove private-key exfiltration. Preserve the initial-access hypothesis, later revisions, and unknown authorization path separately.

Company-level resources and aggregate frozen assets are not token-level replenishment. Admit an XRP reserve-restoration feature only after same-asset, same-chain wallet balances and snapshot liabilities are reconciled.

Do not mix a 06:43 UTC on-chain balance with later unsynchronized market data as if simultaneous. Keep the incident as context-only until point-in-time alignment and walk-forward tests establish incremental predictive value.
